loadImageLibs keeps the last duplicate base name rather than the highest version
syslogLine tells an operator with a renamed 2.x image that env.yaml names no release

unreachable maxDownloadArtifacts check, test-only resolveClosure, exports with no external caller
writeAtomic copies up to the cap before refusing a Content-Length already over it
downloadOne redirect tests cover only a 302 with an absolute same-host Location

fakeDoer.Do never inspects req.Context(), so the shared per-artifact deadline is untested
latestStable's untrusted-<release> branch (versionPublished false) has no test
Stream reports success whenever ctx is cancelled, masking a child that failed before the cancel took effect
ParseCommand duplicates CheckDeployCommand's empty/unsafe checks with different wording, and WriteFile and Preflight carry conditions that can never be false
Image.UserCred/PassCred and the image credential yaml tags have no spec test
Error texts misname the field or cause in Port.UnmarshalYAML and checkSyslog
Raw yaml tag '!!map' leaks from Port.UnmarshalYAML where sibling decoders use YAMLKind
healthStatus comment says generated artifacts declare no healthcheck; both renderers now emit one
Any argument other than --health is silently ignored and the full report runs with exit 0
metric() cannot capture a negative value, so the '-*' arm for an unbounded heap maximum is unreachable
TestRenderPasswordResolution's no-credential assertion only checks the literal prefix PASS=solmq
AllowedCommands is a package-level mutable map rather than a read-only accessor
Test comments cite validate.go line numbers that no longer point at the code they describe
Several charset tests assert only the key name, not that the unsafe-character rule fired; one matrix row is mislabeled and early returns are not pinned
Three copies of the same 'some issue contains sub' helper (hasErr, issueWith, hasWarn), with hasErr also used on warnings
Task names are validated lazily: 'dev.sh build bogus' builds first and dies second, and help is recognised only as the first argument
sanitize() replaces per UTF-16 unit, Go per rune, so a non-BMP character in a connection name yields a different binder name
Consolidate warnings are shown as 'env.yaml: ...' in the page while the CLI prints them bare (and validate never prints them)
Golden workflow fixtures (and their byte-identical shipped example copies) carry U+2014 in comments
get() loses the health document on a 503, so a DOWN instance reports no health lines and the healthcheck logs 'unreachable'
Bind mounts in the quadlet and compose carry no SELinux relabel option, so on an enforcing RHEL host the container cannot read application.yml
downloaded jars land at CreateTemp's 0600 mode in writeAtomic
ApplyTop misreads kubectl top's five-field --all-namespaces rows, so --all --details silently shows no usage
SafeToken and QuoteScalar pass U+0085/U+2028/U+2029, which yaml.v3 (the compose parser) reads as line breaks inside the plain scalars the renderers emit
release job publishes before assets upload; re-run then exits 0 on the partial release
'never written to disk' claim in README and userguide ignores compose writable layer and podman file driver
bash completion walker mis-walks --flag=value and URLs because COMP_WORDS splits on = and :
>> $PROFILE recipe in the PowerShell header appends UTF-16LE under PS 5.1 and corrupts an existing profile
Exit 1 'signal: interrupt' from readLog on Ctrl-C when the follow child exits before cancel runs
On Windows a ':' in --allow-command/--command argv[0] is resolved as a path (no ErrDot), and PATHEXT can turn an allowlisted name into a .cmd/.bat run by cmd.exe
warnIfPVUnchanged fires only on kubectl's 'configured', not 'whenever it re-applies a PV that already existed' as section 8.1 says
The Deployment states no update strategy: a standalone (replicas 1) rollout runs the old and new connector side by side, unlike compose/quadlet which replace the container
Guaranteed QoS claim broken by the resource-less libs-download initContainer in renderDeployment
Compose volume sources carry the unvalidated resolved absolute path; '$' (and ': ' or ' #') are not escaped
Jar integrity is sha1 from the same host; Maven Central's .sha256/.sha512 and .asc are not used
closure resolver ignores <exclusions>, managed <scope> and BOM imports
No TimeoutStartSec in RenderQuadlet's [Service], so a first-start image pull races systemd's 90s default
OS.Run and RunSplit have no deadline or cancellation: a hung engine blocks deploy, status and the watch loop indefinitely
KubernetesPodsJSON and EngineInspectJSON fail the whole status run when one named pod or container is missing
resolveArgv0 accepts a .bat/.cmd resolution on Windows, reintroducing cmd.exe parsing that the SafeToken charset does not cover
runner.Kubernetes deletes without --ignore-not-found, so a remove re-run exits 1 and skips removeNamespace
PodmanRemove stops before removing unit files, so a re-run after a partial remove cannot clean up
KubernetesTop appends every explicit --pod name, but `kubectl top pod` takes one NAME; -d with two pods degrades to a bogus 'install metrics-server' note
False systemd restart count 0 in SystemctlNRestarts for a unit systemd does not manage (LoadState unchecked)
misplacedWorkflowTransforms and misplacedEnvTransforms do not look through aliases or merge keys, so a misplaced transform can still vanish
engineContainer decodes Secrets at the top level, but podman reports them under Config, so podman secret components are never listed
The only behavioural statusscript test proves the parse under the host's GNU sed, not busybox, and skips where sh is absent
CheckDeployCommand lets a bare word follow a value-less flag, so `kubectl --warnings-as-errors krew` smuggles a subcommand/plugin past the flag-shaped rule
graphify hook-guard hooks in .claude/settings.json have no guard for a missing graphify binary
abbrevTable sorts with sort.Slice on Short only; a repeated alias spelling would make the doc nondeterministic
fish target conditions match flag values, so `status --namespace all <TAB>` or `--pod app` hides the target menu
compareProject builds a paste-ready 'docker compose -p <label> ... down' command from an unvalidated container label
TCP logback variant sends bare pattern lines through LogstashTcpSocketAppender, with no syslog PRI or framing, although configured as 'syslog'
checkImage lets image.repo carry a repository path, so Registry() keys the generated pull secret under a host the kubelet never matches
copyText has no rejection handler and dlText/downloadAll revoke the object URL synchronously after click
